title: PROSWIN: Probabilistic Solar Wind Speed Forecasting Using Deep Distributional Regression From Solar Images
abstract: arXiv:2609.26683v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Accurately predicting fast solar wind conditions is challenging, as uncertainties are large and unquantified by traditional single-value prediction models. In particular, the risks of high-speed solar wind streams (HSSs), which can cause damage to technological infrastructure, cannot be reliably assessed without probabilistic forecasts. We present PROSWIN, a probabilistic machine learning model that forecasts the hourly solar wind speed (SWS) at Earth with a four-day lead time. The approach combines solar images and magnetograms using a deep neural network coupled to a distributional regression algorithm. Because standard error metrics underweight the relevance of HSS peaks, we further introduce the prediction score, a model-selection metric that jointly rewards timeline and HSS peak accuracy. translated_title: PROSWIN：基于太阳图像和深度分布回归的概率太阳风速度预报
translated_abstract: 准确预测快速太阳风条件极具挑战性，因为不确定性很大，且传统的单值预测模型无法对其进行量化。特别是，高速太阳风流（HSS）可能对技术基础设施造成损害，在没有概率预报的情况下，无法可靠地评估其风险。我们提出了PROSWIN，这是一个概率机器学习模型，可提前四天预报地球的每小时太阳风速度（SWS）。该方法通过深度神经网络与分布回归算法相结合，融合了太阳图像和磁图数据。由于标准误差指标低估了HSS峰值的重要性，我们进一步引入了预测分数，这是一种联合奖励时间线准确性和HSS峰值准确性的模型选择指标。在14年的数据上，我们的预报实现了非常好的不确定性校准（平均偏差小于1%）。使用连续排序概率分数……
tldr: PROSWIN是一个结合太阳图像、磁图与深度分布回归的概率机器学习模型，可提前四天预报地球太阳风速度并实现良好的不确定性校准，同时引入预测分数指标以更好地评估高速太阳风流峰值。
en_tdlr: PROSWIN is a probabilistic machine learning model that combines solar images, magnetograms, and deep distributional regression to forecast solar wind speed at Earth with a four-day lead time, achieving well-calibrated uncertainties and introducing a prediction score metric to better assess high-speed solar wind stream peaks.
